title: Per-event routing claims it will deliver to Email/Telegram/MQTT that the same page knows are unconfigured
what_happened: In Per-event routing I opened Edit on 'Sequence Paused' and selected the Email (SMTP), Telegram and MQTT transport chips. All three highlighted with a tick, with no warning of any kind. After Save the list row reads '> In-app banner + Email (SMTP) + Telegram + MQTT'. Nothing is configured: no SMTP host, no Telegram bot token, no MQTT broker. The very same page's 'Send test' for email answers 'Failed: Email is not configured' -- so the app HAS the knowledge and does not use it in the routing UI. DB confirms the write: notification_routing_matrix -> "sequencePaused":{"transports":["inApp","email","telegram","mqtt"],...}
expected: Unconfigured transports should be disabled (or chip-labelled 'not configured') in the editor, and the summary line should mark them, e.g. '> In-app banner + Email (not configured)'. A user arming alerts before an unattended night is being told three channels will reach them when none will.
repro: Settings (gear) > NOTIFICATIONS & REMOTE > Notifications > scroll to 'Per-event routing' > 'Sequence Paused' > Edit > click Email (SMTP), Telegram, MQTT > Save. Read the row subtitle. Then scroll further down and press 'Send test' under Email (SMTP).
evidence: /tmp/ns-audit/shots/settings-obs-38-routing-transports.png (all three chips ticked, no warning), /tmp/ns-audit/shots/settings-obs-39-routing-saved.png (summary line), /tmp/ns-audit/shots/settings-obs-46-smtp-test.png ('Failed: Email is not configured'); sqlite3 /tmp/ns-audit/settings-obs/data/skotiq.db "select value from app_settings where key='notification_routing_matrix'"
proposed_fix: Give the routing matrix a per-transport 'configured' predicate (SMTP host non-empty, telegram bot token present in keyring, mqtt broker host non-empty, discord/pushover secrets present) and use it in two places: disable/annotate the chip in _CategoryEditorDialog, and render the summary as '<label> (not configured)' in _categoryRow.
verdict_reasoning: Reproduced end-to-end on display :83 / profile settings-obs-verify. Settings > Notifications > Per-event routing > Sequence Paused > Edit: the transport FilterChips render from NotificationTransportKind.values with no configured-state gating (packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/settings/widgets/notification_routing_settings/category_editor_dialog.dart:83-100) — I ticked Email (SMTP), Telegram and MQTT and got no warning (shot /tmp/ns-audit/shots/sov-24-crop.png). After Save the row subtitle reads exactly '-> In-app banner + Email (SMTP) + Telegram + MQTT' (shot sov-25-crop.png, and the AT-SPI tree returns the same string), built by notification_routing_settings.dart:166-168 which the finding cites correctly. sqlite3 on the scratch DB confirms the write: notification_routing_matrix sequencePaused.transports = [inApp, email, telegram, mqtt]. The consequence follows and is worse than a cosmetic label: notification_router.dart:485-498 (_eligibleTransports) silently DROPS any transport whose isConfigured is false at send time, so nothing is delivered and nothing is logged. The same page does hold the knowledge — router.sendTest returns NotificationResult.fail('<name> is not configured') (notification_router.dart:279-281) and the Email 'Send test' button surfaced a red failure indicator when I pressed it with an empty SMTP host. P1 is correct: this is the arm-alerts-before-an-unattended-night path and the app asserts three channels will reach the operator when none will.
